mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect a pleasant 63 degrees with clear skies around Reddan Soccer Park and a Waning Crescent moon phase to round out the day.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous council vote. This long range vision, developed with extensive community feedback, focuses on housing, sustainability, and supporting our local employment hubs.

We have a busy schedule today with Yoga at Insight Wellness and Hop Haus Trivia happening this evening. Looking ahead, make sure to mark your calendars for the Puppets in the Park event this Friday at Century School Park.

On October 3, a Verona man was arrested by police after they received information from the Cottage Grove department regarding a stolen firearm, which was subsequently recovered during the traffic stop.
Stop by for a scoop of today's flavor, Double Strawberry, which is waiting for you at the restaurant; we are currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM.
